title: Associate-Model Risk Management
description:
Company Profile Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries. As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture. Department Profile The cornerstone of Morgan Stanleys risk management philosophy is the execution of risk-adjusted returns through prudent risk-taking that protects Morgan Stanley’s capital base and franchise. Risk Management protects the firm from exposure to losses resulting from market volatilities and defaults by our lending and trading counterparties. Background on the Position Morgan Stanley’s Model Risk Management (MRM) department resides within Morgan Stanley’s Firm Risk Management Division. Morgan Stanley’s global MRM team, spread across New York, London, Mumbai and Budapest is broadly responsible for the risk management of all of the Firm’s models involving model validation, risk assessment, and governance and act as an effective second line of defence within the Firm. Morgan Stanley is seeking a strong candidate to be a member of the MRM team in Mumbai, focused on the review, validation and risk assessment of models and tools on Traded Risk including, but not limited to VaR, FRTB IMA, RNIV etc. Primary Responsibilities The primary responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to the following: Provide independent review and validation compliant with MRM policies and procedures, regulatory guidance and industry leading practices, including evaluating conceptual soundness, quality of model methodology, model limitations, data quality, and on-going monitoring of model performance Take initiatives and responsibility of end-to-end delivery of a stream of Model Validation and related Risk Management deliverables Write Model Review findings in validation documents that could be used for presentations both internally (model and tool developers, business unit managers, Audit, various global Committees) as well as externally (Regulators) Verbally communicate results and debate issues, challenges and methodologies with internal audiences including senior management Represent MRM team in interactions with regulatory and audit agencies as and when required Follow financial markets & business trends on a frequent basis to enhance the quality of Model and Tool Validation and related Risk Management deliverables. Qualifications Skills required (essential / preferred) Masters or Doctorate degree in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering is essential Experience in a Quant role in validation of Models, in developments of Models or in a technical role in Financial institutions e.g. Developer, is essential Strong written & verbal communication skills including debating different viewpoints and making formal presentations of complex topics to a wider audience is preferred 4-6 years of relevant work experience in a Model Validation role in a bank or financial institution Proficient programmer in Python ; knowledge of other programming languages like R, Scala, MATLAB etc. is preferred Willingness to learn new and complex topics and adapt oneself (continuous learning) is preferred Working knowledge of statistical techniques, quantitative finance and programming is essential; good understanding of various complex financial instruments is preferred Knowledge of popular machine learning techniques is preferred Relevant professional certifications like CQF, CFA or progress made towards it are preferred Desire to work in a dynamic, team-oriented, fast-paced environment focusing on challenging tasks mixing fundamental, quantitative, and market-oriented knowledge and skills is essential

title: Java Technical Lead
description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced Technical Lead with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, and Cloud technologies to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performance banking applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong engineering background, proven experience leading development teams, and a solid understanding of banking business processes. The candidate must be capable of translating complex business requirements into robust technical solutions while maintaining high standards of code quality, security, performance, and engineering excellence. Candidates with experience in core banking, digital banking, payments, lending, banking integrations, or financial transaction processing will be preferred. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Lead end-to-end design, development, testing, and deployment of enterprise-grade banking applications. Define technical solutions, application architecture, service boundaries, and integration patterns. Drive microservices design principles, reusable components, coding standards, and engineering best practices. Participate in architecture reviews and collaborate with solution architects, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders. Identify technical risks, dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for modernization. 
 2. Java & Spring Boot Development Provide hands-on technical leadership in Core Java, Spring Boot, and Spring-based application development. Design and develop RESTful APIs, backend services, and distributed applications. Apply object-oriented design principles, SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices. Implement secure, maintainable, testable, and highly available application components. Conduct code reviews, troubleshoot complex defects, and guide developers in resolving technical challenges. 
 3. Microservices & Distributed Systems Design and implement scalable, loosely coupled microservices architectures. Apply service discovery, API gateway, centralized configuration, circuit breakers, retries, timeouts, and fault-tolerance patterns. Design synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST APIs and messaging platforms. Implement event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies. Address distributed transactions, idempotency, data consistency, concurrency, and resiliency requirements. 
 4. Cloud & DevOps Engineering Design, deploy, and operate cloud-native applications on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Implement containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes or OpenShift. Collaborate with DevOps teams to establish CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management practices. Implement application monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and production observability. Contribute to cloud migration, application modernization, scalability, availability, and cost optimization. 
 5. Banking Domain & Application Integration Understand banking business processes and translate functional requirements into technical solutions. Work on banking applications involving payments, fund transfers, customer onboarding, account services, lending, transaction processing, or regulatory integrations. Ensure secure processing of financial transactions, data integrity, auditability, and appropriate access controls. Integrate with core banking systems, payment platforms, third-party services, and enterprise applications. Follow applicable security, risk, compliance, and data-protection requirements. 
 6. Team Management & Delivery Excellence Lead, mentor, and guide a team of Java developers and software engineers. Review technical designs, estimates, sprint plans, and delivery commitments. Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, QA, security, and DevOps teams. Ensure adherence to development standards, automated testing, code quality, and release readiness. Take ownership of complex production issues, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions. Promote continuous improvement, technical knowledge sharing, and engineering capability development. 
 Mandatory Technical Skills 
 Core Technology Stack Strong hands-on experience in Core Java, preferably Java 17 or above. Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and Hibernate. Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems. Experience designing and developing REST APIs and enterprise integrations. Proficiency in SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, JVM performance, exception handling, and memory management. Experience with Git, Maven or Gradle, and automated testing using JUnit and Mockito. 
 Preferred Technical Skills Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies. Redis or other distributed caching technologies. NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cassandra. API management, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and secure API design. Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry. Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent tools. Cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, and automated security testing. Knowledge of microservices patterns such as Saga, CQRS, and event-driven architecture. 
 Banking Domain Experience Candidates should preferably have experience in one or more of the following areas: Core Banking Systems Digital Banking and Omnichannel Banking Payments, UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, or card processing Retail Banking and Corporate Banking Lending, Loan Origination, or Loan Management Systems Customer Onboarding, KYC, and Customer 360 Banking API Integration and Open Banking Transaction Processing and Reconciliation Banking domain experience is strongly preferred. Candidates from fintech or other regulated financial services environments may also be considered if they demonstrate strong transaction-processing and security experience. 
 Education & Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 812 years of overall software development experience. At least 2–3 years in a Technical Lead or equivalent technical leadership role. Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying production-grade microservices. Demonstrated ability to remain hands-on while leading a team. Strong communication, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and mentoring skills. 
 Key Success Criteria The successful candidate will be expected to: 1. Deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality banking applications. 2. Establish consistent engineering practices across the development team. 3. Improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, and production stability. 4. Ensure timely delivery of technical commitments with minimal production defects. 5. Build team capability in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and cloud-native engineering. 6. Drive reusable solutions and alignment with the overall banking technology architecture.

description:

description:
The Impact You'll Have 
 Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries. 

 The Role 
 The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain's clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle - from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization - and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings. Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time. 

 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications. Architect multi-component pipelines, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning Embedding generation and optimization Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword) Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design: Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain's Responsible AI standards Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering: Hallucination rate and factual consistency Relevance and precision/recall Latency, throughput, and system-level performance Cost tracking and efficiency Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety 

 What We're Looking For 
 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps Deep experience with: Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval) Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection) ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops AI-Specific Tools Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads Comfort operating in high-ambiguity

description:
We are looking for a passionateand detail-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to joinour engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of buildingand scaling our test automation ecosystem owning quality end-to-end, fromtest design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely withdevelopers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust,reliable, and release-ready at all times. 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Design, build &maintain scalable automation frameworksusing Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG. Own test strategy for assigned squads defining scope, coverage, and riskfrom requirements through production. Write BDD feature files (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, andProduct stakeholders. Implement TDD practices writing tests before or alongside code to drivequality in development cycles. Integrate automatedsuites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins,GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback. Perform API testing and validate end-to-end user journeys across web andservices. Identify, document &triage defects with clear reproductionsteps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis. Mentor junior QAengineers and champion quality bestpractices across the engineering org. Continuously evaluate test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps iterating tokeep automation suite trustworthy. 
 
 What We'reLooking For 
 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation in a productengineering environment. Strong proficiency with SeleniumWebDriver page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing. Solid experience with Cucumber(BDD) writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks. Hands-on with TestNG test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, andreporting. Working knowledge of TDDprinciples and integrating tests into agile development workflows. Proficiency in at least oneprogramming language Java or Python preferred. Experience with CI/CDintegration and running tests in automated pipelines. Strong analytical thinkingwith an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes. Excellent communicationskills ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical andnon-technical audiences. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Domain knowledge inPayments understanding of paymentflows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems. Experience testing APIs with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar. Familiarity with performance/ load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6). Exposure to cloudtesting environments (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm). Knowledge of securitytesting basics relevant to financial or transactional systems. Experience with mobileautomation (Appium or similar). 
 
 The Mindset WeValue 
 Beyond technical skills, we hirefor how you think and operate: Ownership mindset you treat quality as your personal responsibility, nota sign-off gate. You proactively identify risks, flag issues early, and seebugs as a systemic problem to solve. Shift-left thinking you involve yourself in requirements and designdiscussions, not just execution phase. Bias for automation if something is tested manually more than twice, youask how to automate it. Collaborative you work with developers as partners, not adversaries,and build shared ownership of quality. Continuous improvement you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices,improving coverage, speed, and reliability.

title: Informatica MDM Developer
description:
Job Summary Synechron is seeking an Informatica MDM Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting Master Data Management solutions. The role will focus on implementing and maintaining Informatica MDM capabilities that improve data quality, governance, consistency, and accessibility across enterprise systems. The successful candidate will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, support reliable data operations, and contribute to business objectives through accurate and trusted master data. Software Requirements (Required and Preferred) Required Informatica MDM Hub: 3+ years of hands-on development, configuration, customization, and production support experience using a current or organization-supported version. Informatica Data Director (IDD): Experience configuring and supporting user interfaces, workflows, and data stewardship activities. Match and Merge Configuration: Experience developing and managing match rules, merge rules, trust frameworks, survivorship logic, and validation rules. Hierarchy Manager: Experience designing and maintaining relationships, hierarchies, and organizational structures within Informatica MDM. SQL and PL/SQL: Strong practical experience with data analysis, validation, troubleshooting, and database programming. Relational Databases: Working experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent relational database technologies. Web Services and REST APIs: Experience integrating Informatica MDM with source and target applications. Data Modeling and Governance Tools or Practices: Experience applying data models, data quality standards, metadata principles, and governance controls. Development and Testing Tools: Experience using source control, defect tracking, testing, deployment, and production support tools relevant to Informatica MDM delivery. Preferred Informatica PowerCenter or IICS: Experience developing or supporting ETL workflows and data integration processes. Informatica Cloud (IICS): Exposure to cloud-based data integration and MDM-related capabilities. Informatica Data Quality (IDQ): Experience with data profiling, cleansing, validation, monitoring, and quality rules. Data Governance Tools: Exposure to tools supporting stewardship, metadata management, lineage, or governance workflows. Agile/Scrum Tools: Experience working with sprint planning, backlog management, collaboration, and delivery tracking tools. Informatica MDM Certification: Certification is an added advantage. Cloud Platforms: Exposure to enterprise cloud environments used to host or integrate data management solutions. Overall Responsibilities Design, develop, configure, customize, and maintain Informatica MDM solutions in line with approved business and technical requirements. Configure and support Informatica MDM Hub, Informatica Data Director, Hierarchy Manager, match and merge rules, trust frameworks, validation rules, and related components. Develop data models, business rules, survivorship logic, and governance controls that support consistent and reliable master data. Work with business stakeholders, data stewards, architects, analysts, and delivery teams to understand master data requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Perform data analysis, profiling, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation to improve data quality. Integrate Informatica MDM with source and target applications using ETL tools, web services, REST APIs, and other approved integration methods. Analyze and resolve development, testing, integration, and production issues within agreed service levels. Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, estimation, code and configuration reviews, testing, deployment, and post-production support. Ensure implementations follow applicable data governance, data quality, security, privacy, and access-control standards. Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, data mappings, test evidence, operational procedures, and support knowledge. Contribute to efficient solution design by reducing unnecessary data processing, supporting responsible use of infrastructure, and considering sustainability impacts where relevant. Deliver maintainable solutions that support business continuity, operational efficiency, data transparency, and measurable improvements in master data quality. Technical Skills (By Category) Programming Languages Essential Strong SQL skills for querying, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and data validation. Strong PL/SQL skills for database procedures, functions, troubleshooting, and data processing. Ability to interpret and implement business rules using Informatica MDM configuration capabilities. Preferred Scripting experience for automation, deployment support, monitoring, or data analysis. Experience working with programming languages used to support REST API integrations or enterprise data services. Databases and Data Management Essential 3+ years of practical experience with Informatica MDM development. Strong experience with Informatica MDM Hub and Informatica Data Director. Experience with data modeling, cross-reference data, base objects, relationships, hierarchies, and business rules. Experience configuring match and merge rules, trust frameworks, validation rules, and survivorship logic. Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent relational databases. Understanding of data quality, data governance, data stewardship, metadata, and master data lifecycle concepts. Experience performing data profiling, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. Preferred Experience with Informatica Data Quality or equivalent data quality platforms. Exposure to metadata management, data lineage, reference data management, or data catalog capabilities. Experience working with large, complex, or highly regulated data environments. Cloud Technologies Essential Ability to support integrations and deployments in the organizations approved environments. Understanding of secure connectivity and data movement between Informatica MDM and enterprise applications. Preferred Exposure to Informatica Cloud (IICS). Experience with cloud-based data integration, data quality, or data governance solutions. Familiarity with enterprise cloud environments, deployment patterns, and monitoring practices. Frameworks and Libraries Essential Informatica MDM Hub framework and related configuration components. Informatica Data Director framework for data stewardship and operational workflows. Experience implementing business rules, validation logic, match and merge processing, trust, and hierarchy management. Preferred Informatica PowerCenter or IICS integration frameworks. Informatica Data Quality capabilities. Experience using approved API frameworks or enterprise integration patterns. Development Tools and Methodologies Essential Experience with requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Experience with defect tracking, source control, release management, technical documentation, and environment coordination. Ability to work within structured delivery processes and follow change-management controls. Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices or equivalent iterative delivery methods. Preferred Experience with automated testing, deployment automation, monitoring, or configuration management. Experience contributing to code reviews, technical estimations, sprint planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities. Security Protocols Essential Understanding of role-based access, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure handling of master data. Ability to apply security and access controls within Informatica MDM and integrated systems. Understanding of secure API integration, protected data transmission, auditability, and least-privilege access principles. Ability to follow applicable organizational data governance, security, and regulatory requirements. Preferred Experience supporting data solutions in regulated environments. Exposure to security reviews, audit controls, data masking, encryption practices, or compliance-related documentation. Experience Requirements Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Informatica MDM development, configuration, integration, testing, and support. Demonstrated experience with Informatica MDM Hub, Informatica Data Director, match and merge configuration, trust and validation rules, Hierarchy Manager, and data governance concepts. Experience translating business requirements into technical designs, data models, configuration specifications, mappings, test cases, and deployable solutions. Experience integrating Informatica MDM with enterprise applications using ETL tools, APIs, web services, or REST interfaces. Experience analyzing data quality issues, investigating root causes, and implementing measurable improvements in data completeness, accuracy, consistency, or duplication rates. Experience with relational databases and strong SQL and PL/SQL skills. Experience supporting production incidents, performing impact analysis, documenting resolutions, and meeting agreed service expectations. Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, or Healthcare is preferred. Experience in Agile/Scrum delivery environments is preferred. title: Junior Developer Intern
description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for a motivated and curious Junior Developer Intern to join our development team. This role is ideal for freshers or early-career developers who want hands-on exposure to real-world product development across both frontend and backend systems. As a Junior Developer Intern, you will support the team in building, testing, and improving web applications. You will work with modern technologies such as React.js, Angular, Node.js, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap, while learning engineering practices, debugging workflows, and collaborative development processes. Along with core engineering skills, this role also expects comfort with AI-assisted development workflows to improve speed, learning, debugging, and documentation quality in day-to-day work. This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning quickly, and contributing to live projects in a fast-paced environment. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Assist in the development and maintenance of web applications across frontend and backend layers. Support the team in building responsive, user-friendly interfaces using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, React.js, and Angular. Help develop and maintain backend APIs and server-side logic using Node.js. Write clean, readable, and maintainable code under guidance from senior developers. Participate in bug fixing, troubleshooting, testing, and performance improvements. Collaborate with designers, developers, and project stakeholders to understand requirements and implement solutions. Work with version control systems such as Git for code collaboration and tracking changes. Assist in integrating APIs, third-party libraries, and backend services. Use AI-assisted development tools to support coding, debugging, code review, documentation, test case generation, and faster issue resolution, while validating outputs for accuracy and quality. Leverage AI tools to improve development productivity, understand unfamiliar codebases, and accelerate learning of frameworks, libraries, and best practices. Learn and follow coding standards, development workflows, and deployment practices. Actively participate in team discussions, sprint planning, reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 Basic understanding of frontend-development concepts and responsive web design. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Familiarity with at least one modern frontend framework such as React.js or Angular. Basic understanding of Node.js and backend development concepts. Understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture. Familiarity with databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL at a foundational level. Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub or other version control tools. Understanding of debugging, testing, and problem-solving fundamentals. Comfort using AI-assisted developer tools for code suggestions, debugging support, documentation, learning assistance, and productivity improvement with proper human review. Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in a project environment. Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team. 
 
 Preferred Traits 
 Strong learning mindset and enthusiasm for software development. Attention to detail and commitment to code quality. Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and follow through. Curiosity to explore both frontend and backend technologies. Positive attitude toward feedback and continuous improvement. 
 
 Who Should Apply 
 Fresh graduates or final-year students in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields. Candidates with internship, academic, freelance, or personal project experience in web development. Individuals looking to build a career in full-stack or web application development.
